summary.short_summary: The team concentrated on enhancing sales momentum in January and February, particularly within the UK market. Andrew Day pointed out a stalled print deal worth £550k due to buyer indecisiveness, stressing the need for swift deal progression. There was an agreement to target UK businesses for easier sales, while diversifying deal types to include CTV and gaming companies to broaden their portfolio. Despite high website traffic, NDA sign rates were low, prompting discussions on improving outreach via direct calls. The operational challenges included technical issues with outreach tools that hindered campaign progress. The team agreed on the importance of proactive engagement with buyers to maintain momentum and avoid deal drift, especially with key projects like Substance and Pixel Decks.
